other_positions: Report separately; never treat three positions as three independent bases.
unsupported_denominator: All preregistered bases remain in the end-to-end mean; unsupported and failed entries have zero contribution and explicit status. Detection-conditioned means report their changed denominator.
sensitivity_gate: clean > subject_corrupt for every backend on the same base
ratio_population: Common bases passing the sensitivity and minimum-drop gates for all compared columns; also report per-column diagnostic populations and every exclusion.
criterion: Upper CI of masked zero R < 0.5 and official CI contains 1; exclude is a separately reported diagnostic.
aggregation_repair: Published implementation: 0.5 adjacent + 0.5 all_pairs; preserve as shipped.
masked_repair: All_pairs, clamped nonnegative cosines; zero uses fixed C(T,2).
